style.styleTitle: Festive Rabbit First Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: Mark a little one s first Christmas with this personalised festive rabbit bauble. It can be personalised with the child s full name, date of birth, birth weight and your chosen Christmas wording. The design is printed onto a shaped wooden insert and displayed inside a clear glass bauble with artificial snow, finished with a velvet ribbon in a colour of your choice. A lovely personalised Baby s First Christmas decoration, animal ornament and keepsake gift. The bauble measures.
